prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

Please provide the complete policy declarations page for the liability coverage applicable to your insured, including the bodily injury policy limits and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also request written confirmation of the coverage position taken on this claim.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and telematics, repair and appraisal records, witness information, and all internal communications concerning liability or valuation. Any loss, alteration, or destruction of such materials may result in sanctions.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and identify the adjuster assigned to this claim. We look forward to your prompt response.
